transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Doctor. Thank you so much for fitting me in, I really appreciate it. I, uh... I hope I'm doing this right, and I don't want to be a bother. 

I'm mostly here because... well, things have been a little stressful at my apartment lately. I don't want to sound like I'm just complaining, but I know the people living there are watching my comings and goings. And, um, they keep slipping notes about me to the management office. 

Everybody keeps telling me I'm wrong and that it's just regular maintenance notices they put on all the doors, but... I know what's going on. I hope it's okay that I came to talk to you about it. Does that sound like the kind of thing I should be here for?
Do you think these people are watching you for a specific reason?

Well, doctor... I'm not exactly sure what the reason is. I really try to be a good neighbor and stay out of everybody's way, you know? I don't want to sound like I'm making things up—I know how bad that probably sounds. 

But... like I was saying, I just know they're keeping track of my comings and goings. Even with everyone telling me those papers are just regular notices on the doors, I know they're actually slipping notes about me to the office. I'm sorry to repeat myself, I just... I really don't know why they'd single me out like this. Does that sound silly to you? I hope I'm explaining this okay.
Do you think these beliefs about your neighbors might not be true, even for a moment?

I mean... I guess I try to keep an open mind, because I know I'm not always right about everything. I really don't want to be one of those people who just stubbornly insists on things when everyone else says otherwise. 

But... I just feel it so strongly, you know? Like, I know they're watching my comings and goings. And those notes they slip to the office... I know people say they're just regular door notices, but I just can't shake the feeling that they're about me. 

I'm sorry, I know that probably sounds really stubborn or... or crazy. I don't mean to be difficult. Do you think I'm just being paranoid? I really value your opinion on this.
Have you ever heard voices or sounds that other people can't hear?

Oh, um... no. No, I haven't experienced anything like that. I've never heard voices or, you know, sounds that aren't there. 

I really hope I'm not giving you the wrong impression with all the stuff about my neighbors. I know I must sound a bit... much, but my hearing is perfectly fine, and I don't hear people talking to me when I'm alone or anything like that. I promise I'm being completely honest with you about that. Is it okay that I don't have that symptom? I know you have to ask these things to figure out what's wrong with me.
How long have you believed that your neighbors are watching you?

Well, um... I guess it's been a little while. I really try not to make a big deal out of it, because I know how it must sound to you. But... those thoughts, about the apartment neighbors and the office... they've been with me for about a year and a month now. Give or take a little. 

I'm really sorry it's been going on for so long without me getting proper help. I just kept hoping it would blow over and I wouldn't have to bother anyone with it. I hope you don't think I'm too far gone or anything for letting it go on this long. Does that timeline help you with your notes?
Do you think it's possible that your neighbors are not actually watching you, or is this something you're completely certain about?

Well, I... I try really hard to listen to what other people tell me. Like, everybody keeps telling me they're just regular notices on the doors, you know? And I don't want to be difficult or argue with anyone. I really don't. 

But... it's just so hard to ignore what I see. I know they're watching my comings and goings. And I know those notes they slip to the office are about me. I came in today because... well, because it's just so overwhelming, and I want to do whatever I'm supposed to do to fix it. 

I know it probably sounds like I'm not listening to reason, and I'm so sorry if I'm being frustrating. I just... I can't seem to turn off that feeling that it's all true. Is it okay that I still feel that way, even when people tell me otherwise? I'm really trying my best to be cooperative.
Do you have any other thoughts or beliefs that you're convinced are true, even if others disagree with you?

Oh, um... no. No, nothing else like that. I really try my best to be reasonable about most things, you know? It's... it's really just that situation with the neighbors that I can't seem to shake. 

I don't have any other strange ideas, I promise. I always try to listen to folks when they tell me how things actually are, I really do. I just want to be easy to work with. I hope it's okay that I don't have anything else to add for that question. Does it make your job a little easier if it's just the one main issue we have to focus on?
How certain are you that your neighbors are watching you?

Well, I... I guess I'm pretty certain. I mean, I don't want to be stubborn about it, and I know I already mentioned it, but... I came in today because I just *know* the people at my apartment are watching my comings and goings. And I know they're slipping those notes about me to the office. 

I know everybody keeps telling me they're just regular notices on the doors, and I really, really try to believe them. I don't want to make a fuss. But it just feels so real to me, you know? I hope I'm not repeating myself too much, I just want to make sure I'm answering your question right. Is it helpful that I'm being honest about how sure I feel, even if it sounds a little silly?
Would you still believe your neighbors are watching you even if I showed you evidence that they are not?

Oh, gosh... I mean, if you had proof, I would really, really try to believe you. I'd want to look at whatever you showed me and just say, 'Okay, Doc, you're right and I'm wrong.' I don't want to be a bother or argue with you. 

But... honestly? I think deep down, I'd still feel like... well, like I know what I know. I know I keep bringing it up, and I'm sorry to sound like a broken record, but I just know they're watching my comings and goings and slipping those notes to the office. Even with everybody telling me they're just regular door notices, it just doesn't feel that way to me. 

I'm sorry, does that make me a bad patient? I really want to agree with you, I promise I do, but that feeling is just so strong. I hope it's alright that I'm being completely honest with you about it. I'm trying to do this right.
Have you ever had any other beliefs that you were completely convinced of, despite others telling you they were not true?

Oh, no, sir. I really haven't. I... I know I keep coming back to the exact same thing, and I'm so sorry if I'm not giving you the kind of answers you need today. I really don't mean to be difficult or hold up your time. 

It's truly just that one situation I mentioned before... about knowing the folks at my building are watching my comings and goings, and slipping those notes to the office about me. I know everyone says they're just regular notices on the doors, and I really try to listen to them, but that's the only thing I've ever felt this strongly about. 

I've never had any other ideas like that, I promise. I try to be a pretty reasonable guy otherwise, you know? I hope it's okay that it's just this one main issue I'm dealing with. Am I doing alright with your questions so far? I just want to make sure I'm giving you what you need.
Have you ever had any other beliefs that you held onto for a long time, despite others telling you they were not true?

No, doctor, honestly, I haven't. I... I know I'm probably sounding like a broken record, and I'm really sorry to keep bringing it up, but it really is just that one thing. I've never been the type to get strange ideas or argue with folks about things. 

It's just... well, like I said, I just know the people at my apartment are watching my comings and goings, and slipping those notes to the office about me. Even though everybody keeps telling me they're just normal notices on the doors. That's really the only time I've ever felt this way about something when other people disagreed with me. 

I try my best to be agreeable and get along with everyone. I hope I'm not frustrating you by giving you the same answer again. I'm just trying to be as honest as I can... is that okay?
Have you ever had any other thoughts or beliefs that you were certain were true, but others disagreed with you?

Oh, dear... I'm really starting to worry that I'm not giving you the right answer, Doc. I feel terrible. Am I misunderstanding what you're asking? I promise I'm searching my memory, but I really haven't had any other thoughts like that. 

It's truly just the one thing I came in for... the situation with the folks at my apartment watching my comings and goings, and slipping those notes about me to the office. Even with everybody telling me it's just regular notices on the doors, that's the only time I've ever felt certain about something when others didn't. 

I'm so sorry, I feel like I'm failing your test here by saying the exact same thing again. I would tell you if there was anything else, I really, really would. Are we doing okay? I just want to make sure I'm being a good patient for you.
Have you ever had any other thoughts or beliefs that you were certain were true, but turned out to be false?

Oh, goodness... Doctor, I... I really must be doing a terrible job today. I'm so, so sorry. I feel like I'm just frustrating you by repeating myself, but I swear on my life I don't have any other thoughts like that. 

It's just... well, just what I came in for. Knowing that the people at my apartment are watching my comings and goings, and slipping those notes about me to the office. And I know everybody keeps telling me it's just regular notices on the doors, and I try to believe them, I really do... but that's the absolute only thing. 

Please tell me I'm not ruining this interview. I'm trying my absolute best to give you the answers you need... is there something else I should be saying? I just want to be helpful.
Have you ever had any other thoughts or beliefs that you were certain were true, for more than a month, but others disagreed with you?

Doctor, I... I'm really starting to feel like a bother, and I hate that. I know you keep asking, and I want so badly to give you a different answer so you can do your job properly. I'm so sorry. I just... I haven't had anything else. 

I've been thinking and thinking, and it's still just the one thing. I just know, deep down, that the folks in my building are keeping tabs on when I leave and when I come back, and they're passing those notes about me to the management. Even when everyone insists they're just standard flyers on the doors... that's the only time I've ever been so sure of something when everyone else said I was wrong. And it's been going on for a while now.

I hope you're not upset with me for being a broken record. I'm really trying to be cooperative, I promise. Am I doing okay? I just want to make sure I'm giving you what you need.
How would you react if I showed you video evidence that your neighbors are not watching you?

Oh, goodness... well, if you showed me a video... I suppose I would have to look at it. I really would try to look at it with an open mind, Doctor. I know you're just trying to help me, and I want to be agreeable. 

It's just... it's so hard because I *know* they're watching my comings and goings. I know they're slipping those notes about me to the office. Even when everybody keeps telling me it's just regular notices on the doors, it feels so real to me. But if you went to all the trouble to get a video to show me... I would try my very best to believe you. I wouldn't want to argue with you, I promise. 

Would that be the right way to handle it? I just want to make sure I'm working with you, not against you. I really don't want to be a difficult patient.
Have you ever had any other thoughts or beliefs that you were certain were true for more than a month, despite others telling you they were not true?

Doctor, I... I feel just terrible. I know you're asking me again, and it makes me worry I'm not giving you the right answer. I am so, so sorry. I really don't want to be a nuisance or waste your time. 

I've been sitting here racking my brain, trying so hard to come up with something else for you, but... it really is just the one thing. Just what brought me in here in the first place. Knowing that the people at my apartment are watching my comings and goings, and slipping those notes about me to the office. Even with everybody keeping on telling me it's just regular notices on the doors... that's the absolute only thing I've been stuck on for this long. 

I'm not holding anything back from you, I swear it. I just want to do whatever I can to help you help me. Are you... are you getting frustrated with me? I'll keep trying to think of something else if you really need me to, I promise.
Have you ever had any other thoughts or beliefs that you were certain were true for more than a year?

Oh, dear... I really hope I'm not frustrating you, Doctor. I feel like I'm failing a test because I still don't have any other new things to tell you about. I'm so sorry. 

But... um, since you specifically asked about it being more than a year... I suppose I need to be completely honest with you. I didn't want to say the exact timeframe before because I was a little ashamed, and I didn't want you to think worse of me... but those thoughts about the neighbors watching me and reporting to the office... they've actually been with me for about a year and a month now. 

I hope it's alright that I'm just telling you how long it's been going on. I just get so embarrassed, and I want you to see that I'm doing my best to hold it together. Does that help answer your question? I really am trying to give you exactly what you need.
Have you ever had any other thoughts or beliefs that you were certain were true, but others disagreed with you, that lasted for more than 6 months?

Oh, Doctor, I... I really don't want you to think I'm being stubborn or—or not listening to you. I know you're asking about other things again, and I feel just awful that I keep giving you the same answer. I really am trying to be helpful, I promise.

But it's just... it's just the one thing. The same thing we've been talking about, with the people at my apartment watching my comings and goings, and slipping those notes to the office. Even when people tell me they're just regular door notices, I just... I know what I know. And like I said, it's been going on for over a year now, so it definitely covers the six months you're asking about. 

I'm so sorry I don't have anything new to tell you. I'm not trying to be difficult, I just... I want to make sure I'm giving you the right information. Is it okay that it's just this one thing? I hope I'm not messing up your evaluation...
Do you think your belief about your neighbors is part of a larger plan or scheme?

Oh, um... a larger plan? I... I don't think so. I really don't want to sound like I'm, you know, making up some crazy story or anything. I just... I just know what I've been seeing at the apartment. 

It's just that specific thing, with them watching when I come and go, and then those notes going to the office. I know everyone says they're just normal notices, and I really, really try to see it their way, but... I just know what's happening to me. But it's not like a big conspiracy or a scheme or anything like that, I promise. It's just my neighbors being... difficult. 

Does that make sense? I'm trying so hard to explain it right so you don't think I'm completely losing my mind. I just want to give you the exact truth of what's been going on. Am I doing okay?
